We are looking for an Agentic AI Principal to act as a senior technical authority and trusted client advisor for complex agentic AI transformation in Germany, the Netherlands and the wider DACH region.
 Operating at Principal level, you will shape enterprise AI strategy, define agentic architecture blueprints, lead high-value C-suite engagements and guide complex programmes from opportunity through delivery. You will bring deep hands-on credibility in multi-agent systems, governance and safeguards, while setting reusable patterns and raising capability across teams.
 The role has particular focus on sovereign, compliant and production-grade agentic AI for regulated German, Dutch and European enterprises, with a primary focus on healthcare and life sciences (pharma, biotech, medtech and healthcare providers). Experience from other regulated sectors, such as financial services and insurance, automotive and manufacturing, energy and telecommunications, is equally welcome.
 Our delivery model is moving from large time-and-materials teams to small, AI-first, multidisciplinary pods accountable to a business outcome. You will anchor the agentic side of that work, pairing with our data, tech advisory and industry domain leads from presale through delivery.
 This is a client-facing, builder's leadership role. You will start with a small, senior team and grow it through technical depth, delivery excellence and thought leadership, rather than inheriting a large organisation.
 Job responsibilities
 Shaping and winning 
 Agentic AI advisory and strategy: shape and solution complex German, Dutch and DACH pursuits with account, commercial and delivery leaders, translating client needs into differentiated propositions, credible architectures and executable delivery approaches that support regional pipeline conversion.
 Independently drive complex pursuits with technical and executive stakeholders, including shaping the commercial model (fixed-price, outcome-linked), trade-offs and risk.
 Act as a sparring partner to C-suite buyers (CEO, CIO, CDO, CISO, COO): frame business-outcome hypotheses, challenge assumptions and define a thin slice of agentic delivery that proves value quickly.
 Lead AI maturity assessments, identify and prioritise processes for agentisation, and connect architecture choices to measurable business value and ROI.
 Represent Thoughtworks' agentic AI expertise in strategic client conversations, industry forums, partnerships and thought leadership where appropriate.
 Designing and building 
 Design and build engineering: set the architecture direction for complex, production-grade agentic AI systems, including multi-agent workflows, orchestration, tool use, memory, context strategy, retrieval, evaluation, observability and enterprise integration.
 Integrate agents with the German enterprise core: SAP (S/4HANA, BTP), LIMS, QMS and clinical systems, MES/PLM and industrial systems, and legacy back-office platforms, using open protocols such as MCP and A2A where they fit.
 Ensure agents run on trustworthy data foundations, working with data engineering and data product teams on data quality, semantics and access.
 Design solutions for regulated German and EU environments, with strong consideration of data sovereignty (EU and German sovereign cloud, open-weight or self-hosted models where required), privacy, security, responsible AI and applicable regulation, including the EU AI Act and GDPR; for healthcare and life sciences GxP, EU MDR/IVDR and the European Health Data Space; and for other sectors DORA, NIS2 and BaFin requirements where relevant.
 Guide teams in balancing rapid experimentation with robust production engineering, including evaluation-driven development, testing, CI/CD, reliability, cost and performance optimisation.
 Provide technical and delivery leadership for complex programmes, staying hands-on enough to validate architecture, unblock teams, manage technical risk and ensure successful execution.
 Partner with product, data, software engineering, enterprise architecture, governance and change specialists to design end-to-end solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.
 Governance and safeguards 
 Establish reusable patterns for observability, auditability, traceability and control of agentic systems, enabling teams to demonstrate safe and reliable behaviour in production.
 Translate EU AI Act obligations (risk classification, human oversight, logging, technical documentation, GPAI-provider responsibilities) into concrete engineering controls and evidence.
 Engage early with works councils (Betriebsrat, ondernemingsraad), data protection officers and information security, supporting DPIAs and co-determination processes so agentic solutions that touch employee workflows can go live.
 Anticipate technical, organisational and governance challenges in enterprise AI adoption and define practical approaches to address them.
 Principal-level leadership and growing capability 
 Set reusable architecture patterns, engineering standards and governance practices across multiple teams and engagements, influencing the evolution of Thoughtworks' agentic AI capability beyond an individual programme.
 Set technical direction across multiple teams and initiatives, defining reusable patterns, frameworks and engineering standards for agentic AI delivery.
 Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, build the next generation of the German team, and raise AI fluency and agentic engineering standards across specialists and generalists.
 Evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies and frameworks and guide their responsible adoption based on client context, engineering quality and business value.
 Build our German and Dutch market presence through local-language points of view, ecosystem and partner initiatives (hyperscalers, SAP, European model providers) and community events.
 Job qualifications
 Technical Skills
 Deep expertise in modern software engineering and Python, with a strong track record of setting standards for testing, CI/CD, observability, maintainability and production reliability.
 Recognised experience architecting and delivering complex GenAI and agentic AI systems at enterprise scale, from early discovery through production deployment.
 Deep knowledge of agentic architectures and frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex or equivalent, including tool use, orchestration, memory, multi-agent coordination and interoperability protocols (MCP, A2A).
 Strong expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation, advanced information retrieval, vector databases and enterprise knowledge integration.
 Experience designing evaluation strategies for GenAI and agentic systems, including quality, safety, reliability, latency and cost measures.
 Strong understanding of AI governance and safeguards, including guardrails, red-teaming, observability, responsible AI and secure deployment practices (prompt injection, data leakage, tool misuse).
 Significant experience deploying AI systems on major cloud platforms using containers, orchestration and production-grade infrastructure patterns, including EU sovereign cloud, hybrid or on-premises setups and self-hosted open-weight models.
 Experience with model adaptation and optimisation techniques, including prompt/context engineering, fine-tuning where appropriate, and application-level performance optimisation.
 Ability to make sound architecture trade-offs across model capability, reliability, security, compliance, performance and cost.
 Working knowledge of the EU AI Act, GDPR and sector rules (for healthcare and life sciences: GxP and GAMP 5 computerised-system validation, EU MDR/IVDR, EHDS; for other sectors: DORA, NIS2, BaFin) and how they shape agentic system design.
 Strongly preferred: delivering AI in healthcare or life sciences (e.g. R&D, clinical, regulatory, manufacturing quality, commercial).
 Nice to have: integrating agents with SAP and industrial or manufacturing systems; data product and data platform foundations for AI.
 Consulting and Commercial Track Record
 Proven ability to lead C-suite and senior client engagements, rapidly establish credibility and advise on both business and technical choices.
 Strong consulting and commercial judgement: you can point to data and AI (ideally agentic or GenAI) pursuits you helped shape, sell and deliver in the last three to five years, from around €3M–5M upwards, including fixed-price or outcome-linked elements.
 Experience shaping, solutioning, selling and delivering complex deals of €5M+ in the last few years. Annual target of solutioning, selling and delivering €10M+ TCV in Data & AI deals with an AI-first delivery focus.
 Comfortable discussing P&L, business cases and ROI with executive buyers, not just architecture.
 Consultancy or professional-services experience within the last five years, ideally with German, Dutch or DACH enterprise clients.
 You have grown a practice, capability or go-to-market asset (e.g. a reusable accelerator).
 Professional Skills
 Executive presence and communication skills, making complex agentic AI concepts, risks and trade-offs clear to technical and non-technical audiences.
 Proven leadership of complex delivery across multidisciplinary teams, moving fluidly between strategy, architecture, governance and hands-on technical leadership.
 Ability to influence across organisations without formal authority, align diverse stakeholders and navigate ambiguity in high-value or high-risk programmes.

 Self-directed, prioritisation-led working style, with creative problem-solving in fixed-scope, outcome-driven work.
 Experience navigating German stakeholder structures, including works councils, data protection officers and procurement.
 German B2 minimum , C1 strongly preferred; fluent English. 
 Other things to know
 Learning & Development
 There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow.  At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.
Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.

We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment .

As a leading technology consultancy, we’re pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let’s be extraordinary.

description:
Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. 
 We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world.
 We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today.
 Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development.
 We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation.
 About the role
 You’ll build backend systems that make our lab programmable. You'll architect data pipelines that process large-scale protein characterization data, build APIs that integrate laboratory instruments and robotics into our software stack, and work closely with scientists and automation engineers to translate complex molecular biology workflows into reliable, scalable software. This is not SaaS slop, you're making physical machines do precise biology with minimal human intervention.
 What we're looking for 
 Strong experience designing and building production backend systems. We use Python and TypeScript on the backend with Postgres, but what matters is that you can architect systems that are reliable and maintainable.
 Experience building data pipelines and processing infrastructure. You'll be handling large volumes of heterogeneous data from physical instruments such as binding kinetics data, enzyme activity measurements, chromatography readings, and turning them into clean, structured datasets.
 Comfortable with API design and systems integration. A big part of this role is making hardware talk to software: connecting instruments, robotics, and scheduling systems into a coherent whole.
 A genuine interest in biology. No background required, but our product is running biology experiments in the physical world and that should excite you.
 High-autonomy, founder mindset. We share context and vision openly. You figure out what matters most and go work on it.
 Pragmatism. You care about solving the problem well, not about the stack or the tools.
 You write code primarily with AI, but you have enough experience writing software without it to know what good code and good architecture look like.
 Application deadline 
 We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
 The Team 
 Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact — understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our team pairs deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.
 The Role 
 As an intern, you will have the unique opportunity to learn and grow through hands-on experiences. Your role will involve utilizing our cutting-edge AI deployment tools to develop innovative solutions for our customers, together with more experienced Deployment Engineers.
 This is not a traditional engineering role where you build everything manually. You will be introduced to AI-augmented and business-focused software delivery: helping specify what needs to be built, learning to direct AI agents to execute, and assisting in validating the results. Participation in team meetings and workshops will offer valuable insights into the decision-making process within the company.
 The Work You’ll Do 
 Initiate and Connect 
 Conduct customer-facing sessions with experienced Deployment Engineers to discuss ongoing projects, translate strategic objectives into use cases, and receive guidance on best practices.
 Assist in gathering and organizing relevant data from various sources, ensuring data accuracy and consistency for analysis.
 Build 
 Learn to direct AI deployment agents (like Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards by helping to write clear specifications.
 Conduct exploratory data analysis, utilizing Celonis and other tools to uncover trends, process inefficiencies, and root causes.
 Assist in defining the initial solution design blueprint and configuring operational solutions across the platform.
 Value & Rollout 
 Support the validation of AI-generated outputs for accuracy and business relevance alongside senior team members.
 Help develop and maintain KPIs to track the success of project initiatives and quantify business impact.
 Assist in documenting solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and customer handover.
 What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era 
 You will learn to work with AI agents as your primary tools, focusing on validating and refining their output rather than writing every line of code manually.
 You will develop foundational specification and context engineering skills to help translate business needs into precise AI instructions.
 As you navigate a fast-paced environment, you will learn how to adapt quickly to changes and new approaches as AI capabilities evolve.
 The Qualifications You Need 
 Student of Technology Management, Business (-Informatics), Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, or a comparable degree program with outstanding performance.
 Know-how in Business Intelligence, data analytics, and a foundational understanding of enterprise business processes.
 Experience in programming and working with databases; knowledge in SQL, Python, or related coding- and/or database query languages.
 Curiosity and basic familiarity with AI-assisted development tools, coupled with an eagerness to learn prompt/context engineering.
 Interest in working with customers, along with awesome presentation and communication skills.
 Ability to demonstrate initiative, work independently, and think outside of the box.
 Fluent in English and German (any additional language is a plus).
 At least 5 months of full-time availability.
 What Celonis can offer you: 
 Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
 Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
 Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
 Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
 Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
 Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
 Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
 Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
 Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.
 About Us: 
 Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
 Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video .
 Celonis Inclusion Statement: 
 At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen. 
 Your Privacy: 
 Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices 
 By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process .
 Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools 
We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.
The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.

description:
We are looking for an AI Inference Engineer to join our growing team. We build and run the inference engine behind every Perplexity query and deploy dozens of model architectures at scale with tight latency and cost budgets. Our stack is Rust, Python, CUDA, and CuTe DSL.





RESPONSIBILITIES: 

 - New models support. Support transformer-based retrieval, text-generation, and multimodal models in our inference infrastructure, from weight loading, request scheduling and KV-cache management to support in API Gateway.

 - GPU kernels migration to CuTe DSL. Port our in-house CUDA kernels to NVIDIA's CuTe DSL so they run on GB200 today and are portable to Vera Rubin racks tomorrow.

 - Rust-native serving runtime. Develop our internal Rust-based inference server to solve all Python pains and keep up with rapidly growing traffic.

 - Performance optimisation. Profile and fix bottlenecks from network ingress through continuous batching and GPU kernels interleaving.

 - Reliability and observability. Build dashboards, alerts, and automated remediation so we catch regressions before users do. Respond to and learn from production incidents.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

 - Deep experience with GPU programming and performance work (CUDA, Triton, CUTLASS, or similar). Any other deep systems programming experience is a plus.

 - You understand modern LLM architectures and are able to bring them up reliably in a production environment.

 - You've built and operated production distributed systems under real load - ideally performance-critical ones.

 - Comfortable working across languages and layers: Rust for the serving runtime, Python for model code, CUDA/CuteDSL for kernels.

 - You own problems end-to-end. You can read a research paper on Monday, write a kernel on Wednesday, and debug a production incident on Friday.

 - Self-directed. You do well in fast-moving environments where the path forward isn't laid out for you.


NICE-TO-HAVE: 

 - ML compilers and framework internals: PyTorch internals, torch.compile, custom operators.

 - Distributed GPU communication: NCCL, NVLink, InfiniBand, RDMA libraries, model/tensor parallelism.

 - Low-precision inference: INT8/FP8/FP4 quantization, mixed-precision serving.

 - Profiling and debugging tools: Nsight Compute/Systems, CUDA-GDB, PTX/SASS analysis.

 - Container orchestration: Kubernetes, GPU scheduling, autoscaling inference workloads.


QUALIFICATIONS:

 - 3+ years of professional software engineering experience with meaningful work on ML inference or high-performance systems.

 - Familiarity with at least one deep learning framework (PyTorch, JAX, TensorFlow).

 - Understanding of GPU architectures (memory hierarchy, warp scheduling, tensor cores).

 - Understanding of common LLM architectures and inference optimization techniques (e.g. quantization, speculative decoding, prefill-decode disaggregation).

Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including experience and expertise.

Equity: In addition to the base salary, equity may be part of the total compensation package.

description:
WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!



Why This Role?

We're seeking an experienced Program Manager to join Cohere's customer-facing Program Management team, with a focus on Canadian public sector and defence accounts. This is a highly specialized role requiring an individual who understands technical program delivery, the technical complexity of frontier AI models and the unique requirements of government and defence organizations.

You will be the critical bridge between our cutting-edge AI capabilities and the specific needs of Canadian federal departments, provincial agencies, Crown corporations, and defence organizations. You'll navigate complex procurement processes, stringent security requirements, data sovereignty concerns, and regulatory compliance while ensuring our customers successfully deploy and scale our AI solutions.

In this role, you'll collaborate with our Strategic Customer team, Applied ML (AML) Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Platform, Product, and Go-to-Market teams, serving as the technical program lead and trusted advisor for our most sensitive and high-impact government engagements.



Location: Ottawa required 

Security Clearance: Active Top Secret clearance strongly preferred; candidates eligible and willing to obtain clearance will also be considered.



What You'll Do

Customer Program Leadership:

 - Own end-to-end technical program delivery for Canadian public sector and defence customers, from initial deployment through production scaling

 - Serve as the primary technical program point of contact for government customers, building trusted relationships with departmental CIOs, IT directors, and technical teams

 - Translate complex government requirements (security, compliance, accessibility, bilingualism, data sovereignty) into actionable engineering plans

 - Navigate government procurement processes, RFP responses, and contractual technical obligations.

Strategic Communication:

 - Provide clear, timely, and objective communication across Cohere's engineering organization, customer stakeholders, and government leadership

 - Translate between AI/ML technical concepts and government-appropriate language for decision-makers who may not have deep technical backgrounds

 - Present technical roadmaps and status updates to senior government officials and departmental executives

 - Represent Cohere's technical capabilities in sensitive government and defence contexts.

Complex Program Management:

 - Create and manage project schedules that account for government timelines, security review processes, and ministerial approval cycles

 - Identify and manage dependencies across government departments, security authorities, cloud service providers, and internal Cohere teams

 - Navigate risks unique to government deployments: privacy compliance, Algorithmic Impact Assessments, Treasury Board submissions, security authorizations

 - Drive alignment between product development priorities and specific government requirements.

Technical Delivery & Execution:

 - Ensure on-time delivery of AI solutions that meet government-grade security, privacy, accessibility, and performance standards

 - Coordinate technical work across multiple teams: model customization, security hardening, integration with government systems, bilingual support

 - Establish governance checkpoints appropriate for high-stakes government deployments

 - Problem-solve complex technical challenges in air-gapped, on-premises, or highly regulated environments.



You May Be a Good Fit If:

Required Experience:

 - 6+ years of experience as a customer-facing Technical or Engineering Program Manager in AI/ML consulting, technology transformation, or enterprise software delivery.

 - Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management.

 - Experience working with government, defence, or heavily regulated customers (public sector, defence contractors).

 - Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder technical programs with stringent compliance requirements.

 - Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; advanced degree or technical certs a plus.

Technical Background:

 - Strong understanding of enterprise software deployment architectures (cloud, on-premises, hybrid, air-gapped)

 - Working knowledge of or experience with modern AI: LLMs, agentic systems, MCP, RAG, fine-tuning, evals, and responsible AI would be a strong differentiator

 - Comfortable discussing API integrations, model inference, data pipelines, and ML operations with technical stakeholders.

Government & Defence Acumen:

 - Deep understanding of how government organizations procure, evaluate, and deploy technology

 - Familiarity with Canadian government requirements: data sovereignty, privacy laws (Privacy Act), accessibility standards, official languages obligations, security classifications

 - Understanding of defence and national security considerations in AI deployment

 - Experience with Algorithmic Impact Assessments or AI ethics frameworks is a strong asset

 - Eligible to obtain Canadian government security clearance (Top Secret preferred)

Nice to Have:

 - Active Canadian government security clearance (Secret or Top Secret) - strong preference for active Top Secret clearance

 - Bilingual (English/French) proficiency

 - Background in or strong familiarity with Canadian defence, intelligence, or critical infrastructure sectors

 - Experience with GC Cloud services (Azure, AWS GovCloud) or Protected B/C environments

 - Project management certification (PMP, PgMP) or government-specific methodologies.



Security Clearance Requirements

This role requires eligibility for Canadian government security clearance.

Strong preference will be given to candidates who currently hold an active Top Secret (TS) clearance, as this will enable immediate engagement with our most sensitive defence and national security customers.

However, we will also consider exceptional candidates who:

 - Currently hold Secret clearance and are eligible for TS upgrade

 - Do not currently hold clearance, but are eligible and willing to undergo the Top Secret clearance process

 - Have a previous government security clearance that has lapsed

Please note that obtaining Top Secret clearance can take 12-18 months. Candidates without active clearance will work on non-classified public sector accounts while the clearance process is underway.



What Makes This Role Unique

This isn't typical program management—it's a highly specialized role at the intersection of frontier AI, national security, and public sector digital transformation. You'll work on some of Canada's most sensitive and impactful AI deployments, helping government organizations harness cutting-edge technology while maintaining the highest standards of security, ethics, and accountability.

If you're passionate about responsible AI adoption, understand the unique constraints and opportunities within government, and want to have an outsized impact on how Canada leverages AI to serve its citizens, this role is for you.

description:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the Role 
 As a Technical Program Manager for Corporate Engineering, you will lead programs that build world-class business solutions enabling every Ant to do their best work. In partnership with Anthropic's IT & Security organization, you will drive end-to-end solutions across the company, delivering the right products, tools, platforms, and experiences for all Ants as they work to create a world for safe and powerful AI. In the simplest terms, you build and drive solutions to enable all of Anthropic to be more productive.
 You will use your technical and program management expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary programs from start to finish. You will work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, lead execution, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You are equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to leadership as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
 This role owns the full spectrum of Corporate Engineering programs: the IT systems Ants depend on daily, first-party and third-party software platforms, endpoint devices, office infrastructure, AV and collaboration equipment, network infrastructure, and the programs that scale our physical office footprint as Anthropic grows.
 Responsibilities 
 Partner across Corporate Engineering domains to drive alignment and delivery : Work with globally distributed product, engineering, and architecture teams to foster collaboration, help teams adopt enterprise standards, and enable faster delivery with consistent practices across the organization
 Define and maintain core architectural foundations : Assist in establishing and maintaining the architectural standards that underpin Corporate Engineering systems, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security as Anthropic grows
 Lead office deployment and scaling programs : Own end-to-end planning and execution for new office buildouts and expansions, coordinating across IT, Facilities, Security, and external vendors to deliver fully operational workspaces on schedule
 Own internal systems and infrastructure programs : Drive programs for all internal systems and hardware deployed in Anthropic buildings, including network infrastructure, AV equipment, printing and collaboration hardware, and building technology integrations
 Lead endpoint and device management programs : Own global programs for corporate laptops, mobile devices, and endpoint management, ensuring Ants have secure, well-managed devices that enable productivity from day one
 Drive IT Operations excellence : Lead programs that improve IT service delivery, support operations, and the overall Ant experience with technology, driving continuous improvement in reliability and responsiveness
 Manage enterprise software and platform programs : Lead programs for the 1P and 3P software platforms Ants depend on, including HR systems, productivity tools, and business applications, from evaluation through deployment and ongoing optimization
 Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders : Work closely with Security, Facilities, People, Finance, and functional teams across Anthropic to ensure Corporate Engineering programs meet diverse organizational needs
 Communicate effectively at all levels : Comfortable communicating across all levels of Anthropic from presenting analyses, recommendations, and program status to leadership, engaging deeply on technical tradeoffs with engineering teams, and communicating broadly to the entire company
 You May Be a Good Fit If You Have 
 8+ years of experience in IT, Corporate Engineering, or Enterprise Technology, with at least 4+ years leading complex, cross-functional programs
 Technical background in enterprise IT systems, including endpoint management, identity and access management, network infrastructure, and SaaS platforms
 Experience leading office buildout or infrastructure deployment programs, coordinating across IT, Facilities, and external vendors
 Proven experience as a Technical Program Manager or similar role in a technology-focused environment, with a track record of leading company-wide programs to successful completion
 Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for executive audiences and engage credibly with engineers on technical details
 Ability to manage ambiguity and drive clarity in fast-paced, evolving environments where requirements and priorities shift
 Strong collaboration skills with proven ability to partner across diverse stakeholders including IT, Security, Facilities, People, Finance, and functional teams
 Strong Candidates May Also Have 
 Experience scaling IT infrastructure in high-growth technology companies
 Background in IT service management (ITSM) frameworks and continuous improvement methodologies
 Experience with enterprise software evaluation, procurement, and vendor management
 Familiarity with modern endpoint management platforms and zero-trust security architectures
 Experience with AV systems, video conferencing infrastructure, and collaboration technology deployments
 Prior technical experience as an IT engineer, systems administrator, or network engineer
 Experience with IT programs in AI/ML research environments or organizations with unique security and compliance requirements
 The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 
 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.
 Annual Salary:
 $290,000 — $365,000 USD 
 Logistics 
 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
 Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
 Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
 How we're different 
 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
 Come work with us! 
 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

Your primary focus will be on designing and conducting data collection tasks, assessing and evaluating dataset quality, and analysing the robustness and generalisability of our models. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including researchers, engineers, and data annotators, to conduct data-driven decision-making and improve the overall effectiveness of our AI systems.



This role combines expertise in statistics, experimental design incl. human annotators, and machine learning to ensure that our models are trained on high-quality data and perform reliably across diverse scenarios. You will contribute to Cohere’s mission of advancing AI by ensuring our systems are robust, scalable, and impactful.



Please Note: We have offices in London, Paris, Toronto, San Francisco, and New York, but we also embrace being remote-friendly! There are no restrictions on where you can be located for this role.



Key Responsibilities:

 - Design and oversee data collection tasks, including supporting human annotators and ensuring data quality.

 - Develop and apply statistical methods to evaluate the quality and reliability of datasets.

 - Analyse and assess the generalisability and robustness of ML systems across diverse use cases.

 - Collaborate with teams to improve dataset quality and model performance.

 - Train and fine-tune large language models (LLMs) on distributed training infrastructures.

 - Conduct experiments to evaluate model performance and identify areas for improvement.



Qualifications:

 - Extremely strong software engineering skills.

 - Strong expertise in designing and conducting data collection tasks, including working with human annotators.

 - Strong statistical skills and experience evaluating scientific experiments related to data collection and model performance.

 - Experience analysing datasets with respect to their quality, biases, and suitability for training ML models.

 - Hands-on experience training large language models (LLMs) on distributed training infrastructures.

 - Familiarity with evaluating and improving the generalisability and robustness of ML systems.

 - Proficiency in programming languages such as Python and ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX).

 - Excellent communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and present findings.

 - One or more papers at top-tier venues (such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, AIStats, MLSys, JMLR, AAAI, Nature, COLING, ACL, EMNLP).



* This is neither an exhaustive nor necessary set of attributes. Even if none of these apply to you, but you believe you will contribute to Cohere, please reach out. We value diverse backgrounds and perspectives at Cohere.



Working Location:
This role can be based remotely or from one of our office locations listed on the job description - there is no minimum in-office qualification requirement. We care most about hiring exceptional people regardless of locations, though please check the location listed on the posting for guidance around the core time zone or working hours alignment expected for the role.




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.

 Monitor the automation and assure result quality

 Assure the quality of results over time

 Customers receive optimization proposals and simulations that are correct and delivered on time.

description:
About Anthropic 
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About the role 
 The Account Abuse team is tasked with ensuring Anthropic's computing capacity is allocated fairly, minimizing resources available to bad actors and preventing them from coming back. As a software engineer on this team, you will build the machine learning systems that help us detect and stop abuse at scale. The ideal candidate can see things from opponents' perspectives, understand their means and motives, and anticipate their responses to countermeasures.
 We're looking for full stack machine learning engineers with experience across model training, productionization, and evaluation. You'll also look for ways to use Claude to speed up how these models get built and maintained.
 This is classical ML on structured and behavioral data. You do not need a deep learning background or knowledge of LLM internals. What matters is that you have trained and shipped models where the stakes are real, and that you care about building robust production systems as much as the model itself. A false positive here is a legitimate customer locked out, so measurement, precision, and safe rollout are part of the job.
 Key responsibilities 
 Build and operate a feature computation platform that serves both model training and real-time scoring, with point-in-time correct training data and low-latency online retrieval
 Train, evaluate, and deploy models that detect account-level abuse and fraud, running them both offline and online
 Build tooling that automates more of the model development lifecycle, including using Claude to speed up feature development, training, and evaluation
 Make backtesting, shadow deployment, and staged rollout the default path to production, with monitoring for training / serving skew, drift, and adversarial adaptation
 Work with our data scientists and our Policy & Enforcement team to improve label coverage and quality
 Partner with product and platform teams to gather signals and integrate model decisions with minimal impact on their systems' latency, stability, or overall architecture
 Minimum qualifications 
 Proficiency in Python and SQL
 Experience training machine learning models and deploying them to production
 Experience building data pipelines with a batch processing engine (e.g., Spark, Beam) and a workflow scheduler (e.g., Airflow)
 Working understanding of point-in-time correctness and training / serving skew, and how to prevent both
 Strong communication skills and ability to explain technical tradeoffs to non-technical stakeholders
 Preferred qualifications 
 Experience building or operating a feature platform such as Chronon, Feast, or Tecton
 Experience with stream processing engines such as Flink, Beam / Dataflow, or Kafka Streams
 Experience training ML models in a production setting with demanding serving requirements, such as fraud, risk, or ranking
 Experience with tree-based models on tabular data
 Experience building unsupervised, clustering-based or graph-based detection systems to surface coordinated account abuse
 Experience in integrity, spam, fraud, or abuse detection
 Experience working with scarce, delayed, or noisy labels
 Experience with AutoML or other approaches to automating the ML workflow
 Care about the societal impacts of AI and want your work to make powerful systems safer
 The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 
 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.
 Annual Salary:
 $320,000 — $485,000 USD 
 Logistics 
 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
 Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
 Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
 We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
 How we're different 
 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
 Come work with us! 
 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. description:
About Us 
Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.
We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem .
Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.
At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.
Visit www.perk.com to learn more.
 About the Role 
 We are hiring our first Director of Go-to-Market Engineering .
 Perk's revenue organisation is 800 people selling to more than 10,000 companies. Behind them sits a CRM, an enrichment and signal stack, a growing set of AI agents - and a lot of manual work that no longer needs to exist. Your job is to remove it and to build the automated systems that replace it.
 You will own GTM Engineering end-to-end: which tools we use, how the architecture fits together, what gets built, and what it does for revenue. You report to the VP of Revenue Operations , lead a small senior team across Europe and North America, and work across SDR, Account Executive, and Account Management - a few high-impact projects each quarter.
 This is a player-coach role, and we mean it. You will be in Clay, in the orchestration logic, in the agent workflows, building alongside a team doing the same. You're using your experience to guide and coach them to accelerate the pace.
 The other half of the job is commercial. The best GTM engineers we have met can sit with a regional Sales VP, work out why their pipeline isn't converting, and leave with the right thing to build. That instinct matters more to us than any single tool on a CV.
 What You'll Do 
 Own the strategy and the stack 
 Define Perk's GTM engineering architecture - how CRM, enrichment, signal, sequencing, orchestration and data layers fit together.
 Make the tooling calls: what we adopt, what we consolidate, what we retire, and why it pays for itself.
 Set the roadmap with the VP of Revenue Operations, Sales leadership, and the Revenue Systems and Data teams.
 Establish the standards the team builds to - version control, documentation, testing, and rollback.
 Build, hands-on 
 Design and build in Clay: tables, waterfall enrichment, AI columns, webhooks and API integrations in production.
 Own the orchestration layer - the logic deciding which records enter a workflow, when, and on what criteria. This is where GTM automation succeeds or fails.
 Build agentic workflows on modern LLM and agent tooling to take research, qualification, summarisation and data entry off people entirely.
 Write the code the job needs - Python, SQL, SOQL or TypeScript.
 Automate across SDR, AE, and AM 
 Own account prospecting automation globally: TAM sourcing, enrichment, ICP and intent scoring, prioritisation and distribution.
 Give AEs their selling time back - CRM autofill, quoting, meeting prep, opportunity hygiene, first outbounds.
 Build account intelligence for Account Management: risk signals, whitespace, account planning.
 Take each project from prototype to production properly - instrumented and validated before it scales.
 Bridge commercial and technical 
 Turn commercial problems into technical architecture, and technical output into impact a revenue VPs recognises.
 Understand Perk's revenue goals and how to leverage AI capabilities for us to achieve them quicker and more efficiently.
 Understand and drive clear and tangible commercial outcomes. For example, how to reduce the time that quota-carrying roles spend on non-core activities such as account research, be able to quantify the impact, and clearly communicate the outcomes to leadership.
 Build the team 
 Lead and grow a small, senior team across Europe and North America.

 Experience 
 Deep background across Revenue Operations, GTM Engineering, Sales Systems, Growth Engineering, or an adjacent technical commercial function in B2B SaaS
 Proven track record in GTM Engineering specifically, with delivery at real scale — systems hundreds of sellers relied on, not a pilot for one team
 Time as both a builder and a leader. This role needs both.
 Technical craft 
 Clay expertise in production - complex tables, waterfall enrichment, webhook integrations and AI column logic that revenue teams actually depended on.
 Deep Salesforce fluency: the data model, integration patterns, and where the constraints really are.
 Working proficiency in code — Python, SQL, SOQL, TypeScript or equivalent. You pull your own data. Not all coding languages are necessary, but proficiency in one or some is required.
 Architecture instincts: you build for scale, monitoring and recovery, not just for the first successful run.
 Depth across several layers of the modern GTM stack - enrichment and data (Apollo, Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Cognism, PredictLeads), signal and intent (6sense, Bombora, UserGems), sequencing (Outreach, Salesloft), orchestration (n8n, Make, Workato), data infrastructure (Snowflake, dbt, BigQuery) and LLM and agent tooling.  You judge your work by whether it moved a commercial metric, not by whether it shipped.

 You understand the funnel end to end: TAM, ICP, pipeline generation, conversion, expansion, and the economics underneath.
 Nice to have 
 Having stood up a GTM engineering function at a high-growth SaaS business, ideally above $100M ARR.
 Experience taking an automation programme from pilot to global production, including what you learned when it got bumpy.
 Multi-region GTM experience across EMEA and North America.
 Why This Role 
 GTM Engineering is a discipline being written right now, and most companies are still treating it as a tooling function.  AI at Perk

 Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.
 Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams 
 All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @ perk.com or @ externalperk.com , our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. Your work will change lives. Including your own. 
 The Impact You'll Make 
 Contribute directly to Recursion's mission of revolutionizing drug discovery through our automation- and AI-powered platform.
 Develop, optimize, and validate cell-based and biochemical assays for deployment on our automated high-throughput screening platforms, enabling the construction of Recursion's Maps of Biology across diverse and often challenging human cell types.
 Execute assay workflows at scale, monitoring performance against defined quality metrics and flagging deviations early.
 Analyze experimental data rigorously to validate processes, troubleshoot systems, and drive improvement, sharing findings and collaborating with a cross-disciplinary team to refine approach and direction.
 Document methods, results, and protocols to a standard that allows workflows to be transferred and run reliably by others.
 Conduct impactful work in a matrixed environment where your insights and ideas are valued and expected.
 The Team You'll Join 
 You will join a cross-functional assay development team working to redefine preclinical drug discovery. The environment thrives on collaboration, open communication, and teamwork across multiple departments. You will work closely with biologists, assay development associates, data scientists, software engineers, automation engineers, and our supply chain team. The team's key output is robust, transferable assays for deployment on a high-throughput screening platform that integrates industry-leading automation to generate petabytes of high-dimensional data from human cells.
 Strong communication skills are essential to our success, as much of our coordination and reporting happens electronically. We value independent thought, self-reflection, and a growth mindset, with a shared goal of continuous improvement. We also believe the best ideas come from diverse perspectives, so if you have suggestions to improve the way we work, we welcome them.
 The Experience You'll Need 
 B.S. or M.Sc. in Biology, Biochemistry, Cell Biology, or a related field with 3+ years of relevant industry or equivalent laboratory experience.
 Hands-on experience developing and optimizing cell-based or biochemical assays, including mammalian cell culture and aseptic technique.
 Working knowledge of core molecular and cell biology techniques, such as transfection, nucleic acid and protein handling, and plate-based readouts.
 Experience with automated, computer-controlled laboratory instrumentation such as liquid handlers, plate readers, and imagers, in 384 and 1536-well formats.
 Demonstrated ability to move experimental work forward independently and efficiently with general direction rather than step-by-step instruction.
 Demonstrated ability to adapt and quickly learn new techniques and instrumentation.
 Careful, consistent documentation of protocols and results in an electronic lab notebook or equivalent.
 A passion for working in a fast-paced environment where you'll apply creativity and independent thinking to assay development for early-stage drug discovery.
 Nice to Have 
 Familiarity with assay qualification concepts and statistical quality metrics, such as Z', signal-to-background, CV, and dose-response fitting.
 Comfort with computational tools for data analysis in Python, R, or equivalent.
 Experience with genetic perturbation approaches such as CRISPR or RNAi, or with omics readouts such as transcriptomics or proteomics.
 Experience working with primary or iPSC-derived cell models.
 **This is a 9-month contractor role with working hours from 9:00am to 5:00pm, Monday through Friday** 
 The Values We Hope You Share: 
 We act boldly with integrity. We are unconstrained in our thinking, take calculated risks, and push boundaries, but never at the expense of ethics, science, or trust. 
 We care deeply and engage directly. Caring means holding a deep sense of responsibility and respect - showing up, speaking honestly, and taking action.
 We learn actively and adapt rapidly. Progress comes from doing. We experiment, test, and refine, embracing iteration over perfection.
 We move with urgency because patients are waiting. Speed isn’t about rushing but about moving the needle every day.
 We take ownership and accountability. Through ownership and accountability, we enable trust and autonomy—leaders take accountability for decisive action, and teams own outcomes together. 
 We are One Recursion. True cross-functional collaboration is about trust, clarity, humility, and impact. Through sharing, we can be greater than the sum of our individual capabilities.
 Our values underpin the employee experience at Recursion. They are the character and personality of the company demonstrated through how we communicate, support one another, spend our time, make decisions, and celebrate collectively.

 Recursion (NASDAQ: RXRX) is a clinical-stage TechBio company decoding biology to radically improve lives. Powered by proprietary multimodal data, purpose-built AI models, and bilingual teams fluent in both science and AI, the Recursion OS is designed to translate complex science into medicines that matter — faster, better, and at scale — for patients who are waiting.
Recursion’s platform infrastructure is anchored in Salt Lake City, Utah and Milton Park, Oxfordshire, where its automated biology and chemistry laboratories generate proprietary data at industrial scale.  As a member of the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will drive the adoption of frontier AI by developing bespoke LLM solutions for top enterprises across Japan.  Partner closely with account executives to understand customer requirements. Configure Claude's capabilities to showcase how it meets the customer's needs. Develop customized pilots and prototypes, as well as evaluation suites to make the case for customer adoption
 Drive technical decision making by advising on optimal setup, architecture, and integration of Claude into the customer's existing infrastructure
 Recommend solutions to technical roadblocks
 Support customer onboarding across Japan by working cross-functionally to ensure successful ramp and adoption. Serve as an ongoing technical advisor throughout implementation and beyond go-live
 Travel occasionally to customer sites for workshops, implementation support, and building relationships
 Establish a shared vision for creating solutions that enable beneficial and safe AI
 Lead the vision, strategy, and execution of innovative solutions that leverage our latest models’ capabilities across Japan
 Minimum qualifications 
 Experience as a Technical Product Manager, Forward Deployed Engineer, or Platform Engineer
 Native-level Japanese fluency and business-level English required
 Designed novel and innovative solutions for technical platforms in a developing business area across Japan
 Strong technical aptitude to partner with engineers and strong proficiency in Python required
 Preferred qualifications 
 4+ years of experience in relevant field
 Recent experience building production systems with large language models
 The ability to navigate and execute amidst ambiguity, and to flex into different domains based on the business problem at hand, finding simple, easy-to-understand solutions
 Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities
 A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. 
 Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
 Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. 
 Logistics 
 Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
 Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
 Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
 Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
 How we're different 
 We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
